result.topic_en: Drafts of a Latin sentence on superfluous features in the usual definition of functions of a complex variable, followed by pencil drafts of the German title page of Riemann's dissertation for its public defence on 16 December 1851 at 11:30 a.m.

items.english: In the usual definition of determinate functions of a complex variable quantity, superfluous features seem to me to be present.
